create_nllb_model: create an NLLB transformer model from an NllbConfig using the create_nllb_model factory function
create_nllb_model_with_factory: build a custom NLLB model by instantiating NllbFactory with an NllbConfig and calling create_model
create_nllb_embedding: create a scaled standard embedding layer for the NLLB model using NllbFactory create_embedding method
create_nllb_encoder: build a transformer encoder with configurable layers and self-attention using NllbFactory create_encoder method
create_nllb_decoder: create a causal transformer decoder with encoder-decoder cross-attention using NllbFactory create_decoder method
